description: Attract-mode demo on level index 2 (LBMZ.HUF), replayed from DEMO.DAT through the port and compared with states observed in the original.

build.DEMO.DAT: local file; one input byte per frame, 1024 frames

emulator.cycles: bridge config default (not visible through MCP); demo mode forces the lag flag to 0, so cycles do not change demo movement
emulator.recipe: docs/port/scenarios/boot-to-level1.md; let the title sit until the attract demo starts. Execute breakpoint at live 01F5:1BB7 (level initialiser return) with cs:[8716] = 2; then a frame-end breakpoint at live 20EA:12BC with ignore_count to reach each hit

capture.method: execute breakpoint at live 20EA:12BC (frame end) with ignore_count; registers and memory read while paused; screenshot via screen_capture raw mode

inputs: DEMO.DAT bytes in order, one per stepFrame call, starting with the first of the two warm-up frames the level start runs

alignment.rule: Frame-end hit k (counted from the level-initialiser breakpoint) is the flip of port step k-2. At that moment the original has run that step's camera follow, tile animations, shots and object scripts but not its player or alien updates, so: player, alien slot, RNG and counts = port after step k-3; camera and object script fields = port after step k-2.
alignment.evidence: Hit 1 is an extra flip during the level start's scroll-in (player not yet placed, seen in the first session). With this rule checkpoints 100, 300 and 500 match without any fitting.
alignment.earlierFittedCheckpoints: The 2026-10-17 checkpoints at frames 28/49 were found by search; they remain as consistency checks of the same run.

checkpoints.source: demo run 2, breakpoint stop with camera 855,680; tile camera from the screenshot offset search (99.3% of sampled pixels exact)
same run, 21 frame ends later; tile camera from the screenshot offset search (99.3% exact)

rules: exact equality for positions, frames and cameras
limits: The original's 48D3 scan also produces 5 phantom spawn records at y = 8 (probes above the map read memory before the row table); they can never spawn (y < 16) and are omitted by the port. Checkpoints after frame 900 are not captured yet.

rngSeed.source: [B07A] (high word of the INT 8 counter) read at 01F5:1BB7 = 1; RNG state there = L 0x0001, H 0xFFFF, history 1 = seedRandom(1)
